sentences.text: Protocypselomorphus was an extinct bird belonging to the cypselomorph group.
This animal belongs to the parent group Cypselomorphae.
Only one fossil occurrence of this bird has been recorded in the Paleobiology Database.
The genus was named by Mayr in 2005.
The type species is Protocypselomorphus manfredkelleri.
Fossils of this species have been found in the Messel Formation in Germany.
It lived between 48.07 and 41.03 million years ago during the Lutetian stage.
